text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup. High 
expectations rest on Hishi Amazon. 
Attention also gathers around her showdown 
with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon had something she needed to 
do. It was about the back Narita Brian 
once spoke of wanting to surpass—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to be at their back, the driving 
force behind their running...! To that 
end, Hishi Amazon vows to win and aim for 
even greater heights.
